mapper.select: SELECT t1.dis_id AS disid, t1.dis_name AS disname, t1.dis_table AS distable, t1.dis_key AS diskey, t1.dis_val AS disval, t1.dis_type AS distype, t1.dis_params as disParams FROM dis_prams t1 LEFT JOIN dis_praams_sub t2 ON t1.dis_id=t2.dis_id WHERE 1=1 AND t2.tab_num= #{tabNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY t2.dis_order
